description: This file contains utility functions for managing etcd storage, including validation of v2 store content, creation of Raft configuration change entries, and extraction of node IDs from Raft log entries and snapshots.

methods.name: AssertNoV2StoreContent
methods.description: Checks if the v2 store contains disallowed custom content based on deprecation stage, logs warnings or returns errors accordingly.

methods.name: CreateConfigChangeEnts
methods.description: Creates Raft configuration change entries to add or remove nodes from the cluster, ensuring the 'self' node is added if missing.

methods.name: GetEffectiveNodeIdsFromWalEntries
methods.description: Deprecated function that retrieves node IDs from snapshot and log entries, delegates to the updated function.

methods.name: GetEffectiveNodeIDsFromWALEntries
methods.description: Extracts and returns an ordered list of node IDs from snapshot and log entries, handling add/remove node conf changes.
